title: Homestead 3 that people refuse to enter

tellings.quote: which is the oldest structure on the property. And it's a structure that some people refuse to enter.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property famous for reports of strange events, tells Michels that the ranch has a building called Homestead 3, the oldest structure on the land. He says some people refuse to go inside it. He speaks as the owner, who has owned the place since 2016, and gives it as one sign of how the ranch affects people.
